item.title: BBC confirms cancellation of I Kissed A Boy and I Kissed A Girl – and fans are devastated
item.description: The BBC has confirmed that both I Kissed A Boy and I Kissed A Girl will not return after this spring's second series of I Kissed A Girl, bringing the UK's first LGBTQ+ dating show franchise to an end after four series. Former cast members and fans have flooded social media with reactions, calling the decision a blow to queer representation on mainstream television.

item.title: Six captains, one trophy, and a whole lot of brass – inside the Women’s Six Nations Kick Off event
item.description: Six captains, free Guinness, and an all-female brass band blasting Hollaback Girl via megaphone - we were at the 2026 Guinness Women's Six Nations Kick Off at the Guinness Open Gate Brewery in London. Here's what England's Meg Jones, Ireland's Erin King and Scotland's Rachael Malcolm had to say about queer visibility, record-breaking ticket sales and why women's rugby is impossible to ignore right now.
